title: Introduce contextual baseline annealing and soft-threshold CI adapter
author: Marceline Ortega
release_notes: Adds a context-aware baseline annealer and a configurable soft-threshold CI adapter to reduce false-positive regression failures for prompt-set checks.
description: Summary: Add a new CI adapter and supporting annealer that adapt the baseline for prompt-set regression checks over time. Motivation: we observe frequent transient CI failures when prompt-set baseline metrics shift slowly (seasonal traffic, tokenizer changes, minor model patching). The adapter implements a controlled annealing schedule and a soft-threshold mode that initially flags degradations as warnings and only escalates to hard failures if the signal persists across a configurable window. This reduces noisy interrupts while preserving regression detection.

notes_for_release: Introduce SoftBaselineScheduler and SoftThresholdAdapter to reduce noisy prompt-set regression failures. Default policy is non-breaking and off by default for existing configs; opt-in via eval config key 'soft_threshold_adapter: enabled: true'.
testing_notes: Unit tests added for smoothing, annealing half-life, and deterministic replay. Integration smoke test included in CI smoke job. Manual QA: exercised example config in local docker-based harness, verified warning->escalate path after 3 consecutive windows by default.
migration_instructions: No migration required for existing prompt sets. To opt-in, add 'soft_threshold_adapter: enabled: true' and tune 'escalation_window' and 'half_life' parameters in your eval configuration file. See docs/annealing.md for defaults and examples.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: misconfigured annealing may delay real regressions. Mitigation: default adapter is off; the adapter in 'warn' mode only opens an incident ticket (non-blocking) and requires at least two sustained windows before escalating. We also added a manual override flag 'force_hard_fail' for emergency lock-downs.
notes: Design rationale: prefer per-cohort half-life scheduling (short-lived cohorts anneal faster) and compact state storage so adapter can run in CI without heavy DB dependencies. The soft-threshold pattern should integrate with existing alerting; the PR includes an example Linear note template for SRE handoff.
